summary: Driven by curiosity and equipped with modern technological skills, I aspire to work in a collaborative environment where continuous learning is encouraged and every challenge presents an opportunity for innovation, contribution, and professional growth.
about: I’m Raj Kaneriya, a Frontend Developer who enjoys turning ideas into responsive, practical web experiences. My work focuses on React.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, reusable UI, API integration and clean component architecture. Through eBusiness and task-management projects, I have built a strong habit of learning by solving real problems and collaborating with teams. I’m looking forward to contributing these skills to a product-focused team while continuing to grow.

highlights: Working on responsive frontend interfaces and practical web experiences.
Contributing to clean, maintainable components and real-world product work.
Completed a six-month internship that improved my confidence and practical abilities.
The hands-on experience strengthened my interest in solving real-world problems and encouraged continuous learning and contribution.

projects.title: Responsive Dynamic eBusiness Website
projects.description: Converted a responsive HTML/Bootstrap layout into React.js and connected it to a local JSON API for real-time data processing and a dynamic user experience.
projects.highlight: Responsive HTML/Bootstrap to React conversion with local db.json API integration.

projects.title: Task Management Web App
projects.description: A responsive React.js web app for creating, updating and tracking tasks in real time, with employee task updates, an admin notification panel and API integration.
projects.highlight: Role-based task workflow designed to improve productivity and user experience.

projects.title: Task Management & OTP Verification System
projects.description: A secure task management web application with email-based OTP authentication and dynamic user management.
projects.highlight: Secure authentication and user management using PHP and MySQL.

projects.title: HRMS – Enterprise HR & Attendance Platform
projects.description: Built an enterprise HR management platform featuring Admin and Employee portals, daily working hours tracking, attendance logging, leave CRUD workflows, time entry management, and light/dark theme support.
projects.highlight: Dual-portal HRMS featuring daily hours tracking, leave CRUD, time entries, and dark/light themes.

certificates: 4 certificates from the Spoken Tutorial program by IIT Bombay.
Completed 7 online courses from Google and IBM and received certificates for successful completion.
